scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/memory && npm run build -w @relay/agents && npm run build -w @relay/mcp && npm run build -w @relay/api && npm run build -w @relay/worker && npm run build -w @relay/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/memory && npm run build -w @relay/agents && npm run build -w @relay/mcp && npm run build -w @relay/api && npm run start -w @relay/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/memory && npm run build -w @relay/agents && npm run build -w @relay/mcp && npm run build -w @relay/worker && npm run start -w @relay/worker
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev"
